title: NPC行为异常影响任务交互
description: NPC行为异常，无法同时说话和执行任务，会在对话中走开，影响任务交互。
evidence: people are unable to talk and do a task at the same time, and NPCs will actively walk off mid conversation because they recalled some random task they needed to do when being offered a job.
